verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows CrewAI acting as an MCP *client* — agents can connect out to external MCP servers via the `mcps` field (crewai-docs-10/28/41/51) — but there is no evidence CrewAI itself exposes an official MCP server that other agents could connect to. Enterprise features mention REST API and webhooks (crewai-docs-42/43) but not an MCP server endpoint.
